_readme: Source for the homepage card spans (build_bits.py) and, later, the technology index. One row per piece. kind: lineup | away | notes. status: wip | on-wax ('on wax' is earned-only — set it when the piece is done). url blank = a slot, rendered as a non-link card. Lineup rows are the batting order: n is the slot (1–9) and the generator derives the label from it (Leading off, Batting 2nd …) — reordering the lineup is changing n, and the slug names the piece, never the slot, so a reorder moves no URL. Seeded from the run's lineup (wax-system: nbtv-brand/shares/keeping-score-content-map.md § 8); edit here as each piece is ruled, then rerun the generator. [[word]] in a title renders as the gold span.
